claim: The General Assembly meets every year on the second Wednesday of January
quote: The General Assembly shall meet on the second Wednesday of January

claim: The session lasts up to 90 consecutive days, extendable by 30 days by three-fifths vote
quote: for a period not longer than ninety days in each year. The ninety days shall be consecutive unless otherwise provided by law

claim: A special session called by the governor is limited to 30 days
quote: When the General Assembly is convened by Proclamation of the Governor, the session shall not continue longer than thirty days

claim: During the session the governor has six days, Sundays excepted, to act
quote: is not returned by the Governor with objections within six days (Sundays excepted), the Bill shall be a law in like manner as if the Governor signed it

claim: Bills presented in the last six days or after adjournment become law unless vetoed within 30 days of presentment
quote: unless it is vetoed by the Governor within 30 days after its presentment

claim: Non-emergency laws take effect no earlier than 1 June after the session
quote: No law enacted by the General Assembly shall take effect until the first day of June next after the session at which it may be passed

claim: State and county officers are elected in November every four years, counting from 1926 (the governor’s cycle)
quote: elections by qualified voters for State and county officers shall be held on the Tuesday next after the first Monday of November

claim: Elected state and county officers serve four-year terms, except certain judges
quote: shall hold office for terms of four years, and until their successors shall qualify

claim: The quadrennial rule does not apply to elected school boards or Cecil County’s commissioners
quote: members of any elective local board of education; or (2) the Board of County Commissioners for Cecil County

claim: A tie for the most votes means a new election ordered by the governor; the top vote-getter wins
quote: any two or more candidates shall have the highest and an equal number of votes, a new election shall be ordered by the Governor

claim: The state canvassers declare elected the candidates with the greatest number of votes
quote: by the greatest number of votes, have been elected to each office

claim: The gubernatorial-year primary is the fourth Tuesday in June; the presidential-year primary is the fourth Tuesday in April
quote: in the year in which the Governor is elected, on the fourth Tuesday in June

claim: Presidential-year primary date
quote: in the year in which the President of the United States is elected, on the fourth Tuesday in April

claim: Baltimore City has its municipal primary in presidential years
quote: In Baltimore City, there shall be a primary election for municipal offices on the fourth Tuesday in April in the year in which the President of the United States is elected

claim: Principal parties must nominate by primary
quote: shall use the primary election to: (i) nominate its candidates for public office

claim: A party may choose to open its primary to unaffiliated voters by notifying the State Board in advance
quote: If a political party chooses to permit voters not affiliated with the party to vote in the party

claim: School board members are elected on a nonpartisan basis, and every registered voter may vote in the school board primary
quote: Members of boards of education shall be elected on a nonpartisan basis

claim: Any registered voter may vote in school board primary contests
quote: any registered voter of the county, regardless of party affiliation or lack of party affiliation, is eligible to vote in those contests for nomination

claim: The school board primary advances twice as many candidates as seats
quote: The candidates, equal in number to twice the number of offices to be filled, who receive the largest number of votes in the primary election shall be the nominated candidates

claim: Twenty counties elect their whole school board
quote: In the following counties, the members of the county board shall be elected

claim: Baltimore City, Baltimore County, Caroline and Harford boards are part elected and part appointed
quote: In Harford County, in accordance with Subtitle 6A of this title, the members of the county board shall be a combination of members who are elected and appointed

claim: Baltimore City school board combination
quote: the members of the Baltimore City Board of School Commissioners shall be a combination of members who are elected and appointed

claim: A candidate not affiliated with any party may be nominated by petition (not for nonpartisan school boards)
quote: A candidate for a public office may be nominated by petition under this subtitle if the candidate is not affiliated with any political party

claim: The petition route does not apply to nonpartisan school boards
quote: Except for a candidate for a nonpartisan county board of education

claim: State election law does not cover municipal elections other than Baltimore City
quote: does not include, unless otherwise specifically provided in this article, a municipal election other than in Baltimore City

claim: Counties are charter, code or commission counties
quote: means a county that has not adopted charter or code home rule

claim: A charter county has adopted charter home rule under Article XI-A
quote: means a county that has adopted charter home rule under Article

claim: Governing body: county council (and executive if any) in charter counties; county commissioners in code and commission counties
quote: for a code county, the county commissioners; (4) for a commission county, the county commissioners

claim: Every charter provides an elected county council; an elected county executive is optional
quote: Every charter so formed shall provide for an elective legislative body in which shall be vested the law

claim: Charter council name and optional executive
quote: in any county shall be known as the County Council of the County

claim: A county council cannot legislate for municipalities on matters their charters cover
quote: nothing herein contained shall be construed to authorize or empower the County Council of any County in this State to enact laws or regulations for any incorporated town, village, or municipality

claim: Commission counties elect commissioners by district, at large or both, as the General Assembly provides
quote: may be elected by the voters of commissioner districts established therein, or by the voters of the entire county, or by a combination of these methods of election, as provided by the General Assembly by law

claim: A code county can enact its own public local laws
quote: a code county may enact, amend, or repeal a public local law of that county

claim: A charter board is elected after a petition or demand, to draft a county charter
quote: for the election of a charter board of eleven registered voters of said City or five registered voters in any such Counties

claim: Each county and Baltimore City elects a sheriff for four years
quote: There shall be elected in each county and in Baltimore City one person

claim: Each county and Baltimore City elects a state’s attorney for four years
quote: who shall be elected by the voters thereof, respectively, and shall hold his office for four years

claim: Each county and Baltimore City elects a circuit court clerk by plurality for four years
quote: There shall be a Clerk of the Circuit Court for each County and Baltimore City, who shall be elected by a plurality of the qualified voters

claim: Each county and Baltimore City elects a register of wills for four years
quote: There shall be a Register of Wills in each county of the State, and the City of Baltimore, to be elected

claim: Every county except Howard, Montgomery and Harford elects three orphans’ court judges
quote: The qualified voters of the several Counties, except Howard County, Montgomery County, and Harford County, shall elect three Judges of the Orphans

claim: The General Assembly may not pass local laws for municipalities; it acts on them only by general law
quote: the General Assembly shall not pass any law relating to the incorporation, organization, government, or affairs of those municipal corporations

claim: Municipalities may adopt and amend their own charters
quote: to adopt a new charter, and to amend or repeal any charter adopted under the provisions of this Article

claim: A charter change may be proposed by the legislative body or by petition of 5% of voters
quote: shall be proposed either by a resolution of the legislative body of any such municipal corporation or by a petition

claim: There is one class of municipality in Maryland
quote: There is one class of municipalities in the State, and every municipality is a member of that class

claim: Municipal voters are those authorized by the municipal charter
quote: means an individual authorized under a municipal charter to vote in elections in the municipality
